referenceEvidence.comparisonValidity: The actual original Home/Store/Quest pixels and actual branch render artifact were inspected before production. The branch has advanced substantially since the render with catalog/art/evidence work, so this candidate is a bounded character-key-art response to the persistent visual-language gap only; it is not a current-head screenshot-parity claim and must be re-rendered before any runtime acceptance.
referenceEvidence.observedDefect: Across the verified originals, the recurring character language is a dimensional, friendly long-brown-haired avatar with an expressive face, polished toy materials and cat-ear headset styling. The inspected current Home/Store/Quest renders remain substantially flatter/blockier and the Quest render is visually inconsistent with that cross-screen identity. Existing avatar-headset-w13-v1 covers only the face/hair/headset layer and remains pending review. This separate full-body key-art candidate targets body proportion, material, pose and silhouette guidance without replacing Workstream 06 equipment ownership or real equipped state.

Simple lavender/cream/jeans/sneakers clothing is explicitly noncanonical visual guidance only. No scene, UI, text, logos, brands or third-party IP.
provenance.negativePromptSummary: No Roblox/Brookhaven/Minecraft/anime-franchise/copyrighted character, UI/text/logo, blocky body, cropped body, extra anatomy or busy scene.
processing: Initial full-body generation was actual-pixel inspected and rejected pre-staging because the hairstyle was too short relative to the consistent long-brown-hair reference cue.
A bounded instruct edit changed only the hairstyle to long, soft, wavy brown hair while preserving the original face, pose, headset, lighting and neutral noncanonical clothing.
The edited 1360x1744 source was actual-pixel inspected before any staging.
Background removal produced the 1360x1744 transparent full layer; producer inspection confirmed complete hair, headset, hands and feet with a clean silhouette.

The source was resized before cutout for the optimized derivative, then background removal produced an 896x1149 transparent derivative; producer inspection rejected no visible alpha/stretch defect in this final derivative.

producerPixelCheck: PASS_PREUPLOAD_ONLY: The bounded final source and both transparent outputs were visually inspected. The character has long warm-brown wavy hair, a friendly expressive face, pink/lilac cat-ear headset, readable full-body silhouette, polished dimensional toy materials and coherent warm/cyan lighting. No UI, text, scene, logo, branded mark or third-party IP is baked in. This is producer inspection only and is not independent acceptance.
